summary: School district expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to avoid financial burdens on rural schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would face unaffordable costs for network hardware replacements
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, losing E-Rate support would force our ISD into impossible choices. Because connectivity is non-negotiable for modern instruction, absorbing those massive network costs locally would directly force us to cut teaching and support staff, delay necessary building maintenance, and trim student programming.

filer_raw: Mecosta-Osceola ISD | Amanda Kimball- Assistant Superintendent of Instructional Services
